# Config reference

Every key of the config file, with what it accepts and its default. `mofsift init` writes
a commented config with the same keys, which is the easier place to start; the guides of
the stages explain what the settings do ([index](README.md)).

- A key that is not listed here is an error, with a suggestion when it looks like a typo.
- Paths are relative to the folder that holds the config file.
- `mofsift doctor config.yaml` validates a config and shows what would run, without
  computing anything.
- The same reference as a JSON Schema, for editors that can use one:
  `src/mofsift/schemas/config.schema.json`.

## Top level

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | text | **required** | Short name of the run; used in file names and the manifest. |
| `seed` | whole number (>= 0) | `0` | Seed of everything random (the 3D embedding of SMILES linkers). |
| `workdir` | path | `work` | Folder for intermediate tables and structures. |
| `filter` | list of text | `[]` | Row filters applied as an explicit step, e.g. 'qc_pass == True'. A row is exported when every filter is true for it. |

## `generate`

Where candidate structures come from.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `generate.source` | `pormake` \| `cifs` | `pormake` | 'pormake' assembles structures; 'cifs' reads existing CIF files. |
| `generate.topologies` | list of text | `[]` | PORMAKE topology names, e.g. pcu. |
| `generate.nodes` | list of text | `[]` | PORMAKE node building blocks, e.g. N16. |
| `generate.edges` | list of text | `[]` | PORMAKE edge building blocks, e.g. E14. Leave empty to connect the nodes directly. |
| `generate.building_block_dir` | path \| `null` | `null` | Optional folder with extra building blocks in PORMAKE .xyz format. |
| `generate.cif_dir` | path \| `null` | `null` | Folder with CIF files (source: cifs). |
| `generate.max_atoms` | whole number \| `null` (> 0) | `null` | Skip structures larger than this. null = no limit. |

## `generate.linkers`

Organic linkers given as SMILES and converted to PORMAKE building blocks.

Optional: leave the section out when you do not need it.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `generate.linkers.smiles_file` | path \| `null` | `null` | Text file with one 'SMILES name' pair per line; lines starting with # are ignored. |
| `generate.linkers.smiles` | mapping of text to text | `{}` | Linkers written inline, as name: SMILES. |
| `generate.linkers.connection_distance` | number (> 0, <= 1.5) | `0.75` | Distance (angstrom) from the anchor atom to the connection point; half a C-C bond. |
| `generate.linkers.conformers` | whole number (>= 1, <= 200) | `10` | Conformers embedded per linker; the lowest in energy is kept. |

## `qc`

Thresholds of the built-in structural checks (distances in angstrom).

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qc.min_distance` | number (> 0) | `0.7` | No pair of atoms may be closer than this. |
| `qc.min_distance_heavy` | number (> 0) | `1.0` | No heavy-heavy or H-H pair may be closer than this. |
| `qc.nonbonded_factor` | number (> 0) | `0.8` | Non-bonded contacts must exceed this fraction of the covalent-radius sum. |
| `qc.bond_factor` | number (> 0) | `1.2` | Multiplier on covalent radii used to detect bonds. |
| `qc.require_single_framework` | true / false | `true` | Reject isolated atoms and extra fragments. |
| `qc.check_valence` | true / false | `true` | H needs one neighbour; C needs two to four. |
| `qc.check_composition` | true / false | `true` | Formula must equal the sum of the building blocks (when they are known). |
| `qc.max_node_rmsd` | number \| `null` (> 0) | `0.3` | Largest accepted misfit (angstrom) between a node and its vertex in the topology, as reported by PORMAKE. null = do not check. |

## `describe`

Descriptors added to every candidate: composition, pore geometry and xTB proxies.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `describe.only_qc_passed` | true / false | `true` | Run pore geometry and xTB only on structures that passed qc. Set to false to run them on every structure. |
| `describe.composition` | true / false | `true` | Composition statistics (always available). |

## `describe.geometry`

Pore geometry from Zeo++.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `describe.geometry.enabled` | true / false \| `auto` | `auto` | auto = run when the tool is installed, otherwise skip and record why; true = the stage is wanted (see on_missing); false = never run. |
| `describe.geometry.tool` | `pyzeo` \| `zeopp` | `pyzeo` | 'pyzeo' = Python bindings (pip); 'zeopp' = the 'network' binary. |
| `describe.geometry.probe_radius` | number (> 0) | `1.86` | Probe radius in angstrom for accessible properties. |
| `describe.geometry.high_accuracy` | `false` \| `OCC` \| `DEF` | `OCC` | Zeo++ high-accuracy Voronoi decomposition (-ha). OCC is the faster setting, DEF the most thorough and much slower on large cells, false turns it off. |
| `describe.geometry.fallback` | list of `false` \| `OCC` \| `DEF` | `[DEF, false]` | Settings tried in this order when Zeo++ stops on a structure with high_accuracy. The column zeo_high_accuracy records which setting produced each row. [] = do not retry. |
| `describe.geometry.timeout_minutes` | number \| `null` (> 0) | `null` | Stop an attempt that takes longer than this; the next setting is then tried. |
| `describe.geometry.on_missing` | `skip` \| `error` | `skip` | What to do when enabled is true and the tool is not installed. |

## `describe.xtb`

Semi-empirical electronic proxies (band gap, band edges) from tblite.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `describe.xtb.enabled` | true / false \| `auto` | `auto` | auto = run when tblite is installed, otherwise skip and record why; true = the stage is wanted (see on_missing); false = never run. |
| `describe.xtb.method` | `GFN1-xTB` \| `GFN2-xTB` | `GFN1-xTB` | The xTB Hamiltonian. |
| `describe.xtb.periodic` | true / false | `true` | Keep true for frameworks: a finite cluster is a different system. |
| `describe.xtb.max_atoms` | whole number (> 0) | `300` | Structures above this size are skipped, not truncated. |
| `describe.xtb.spin` | `high_spin` \| `low_spin` | `high_spin` | Number of unpaired electrons. high_spin: rule of thumb (M(II) high-spin count for Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu). low_spin: none, or one when the electron count is odd. |
| `describe.xtb.electronic_temperature` | number (> 0) | `500.0` | Electronic temperature in kelvin. |
| `describe.xtb.max_iterations` | whole number (>= 1) | `500` | Maximum number of SCF iterations. |
| `describe.xtb.timeout_minutes` | number \| `null` (> 0) | `null` | Stop a structure that takes longer than this and record it as failed. |
| `describe.xtb.on_missing` | `skip` \| `error` | `skip` | What to do when enabled is true and tblite is not installed. |

## `score`

Synthetic-accessibility components, reported separately.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `score.components` | list of `linker_sa` \| `linker_sc` \| `linker_size` \| `linker_rotatable_bonds` \| `precedent_node` \| `precedent_topology` \| `precedent_linker` \| `precedent_pair` | all of them | The components to compute; each one is a column of the same name. |

## `score.strain`

Linker strain. Reserved: not available in this version.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `score.strain.enabled` | true / false | `false` | Must stay false; the component does not exist yet. |

## `score.aggregate`

Optional rank-based summary of the score components. It is not a probability.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `score.aggregate.enabled` | true / false | `false` | Write the column score_aggregate. |
| `score.aggregate.weights` | mapping of text to number | `{}` | Positive weight per component, e.g. {linker_sc: 1, precedent_linker: 1}. Only listed components count; precedent_node cannot be weighted. |

## `export`

The bundle written by the export: table, records for a viewer, structures, manifest.

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `export.out_dir` | path \| `null` | `null` | Folder of the bundle. Default: export/&lt;project&gt;, next to the config file. |
| `export.viewer_bundle` | true / false | `true` | Also write the rows as JSON records (candidates.json). |
| `export.include_cifs` | true / false | `true` | Copy the structure file of every exported row. |
| `export.table_format` | `csv` \| `parquet` | `csv` | Format of the exported table. parquet needs pyarrow. |

## `tools`

Optional explicit paths to external binaries (otherwise they are looked up on PATH).

| Key | Accepts | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tools.zeopp` | path \| `null` | `null` | Path to the Zeo++ 'network' binary. |
| `tools.xtb` | path \| `null` | `null` | Path to the xtb binary. Reserved: this version runs xTB through tblite. |
